stories.title: The Warner Bros. water tower becomes "A Skydance Corporation"
stories.summary: Paramount's merger with Warner Bros. closed, putting DC Studios, HBO, CNN, CBS, Nickelodeon, Cartoon Network and Paramount+ under one company (DiscussingFilm's post got 79K likes). Within hours the Warner Bros. water tower had been repainted with "A Skydance Corporation" under the WB shield, and the jokes followed: "IF YOU SEE DA POLICE PARAMOUNT, A SKYDANCE COMPANY" (47K), and Ryan Gosling's old quote about getting to climb the tower, "I don't know if I'll be able to climb it tomorrow" (31K).
